In-store POS (nightly export, CSV per store)
   -> Autoloader (Databricks Lesson 32)
   -> bronze/pos_sales/{date}/{store_id}.csv
caption: Autoloader picks up only new files, not a full re-scan.

code:
MERGE INTO bronze.online_orders AS target
USING incoming_batch AS source
ON target.event_id = source.event_id
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT *
caption: At-least-once delivery + idempotent MERGE = no duplicate rows.
